text: The authors call a language-model system capable of a task if a small-to-moderate intervention, such as fine-tuning or few-shot prompting with a moderate amount of high-quality task data, makes it perform well, and call it misaligned if it is capable in this sense but performs poorly under naive zero-shot prompting.
title: Capability vs alignment as used in sandwiching: capable but misaligned model
